title: polarisationIndex operation
description: The PROPS BENCH of the multi-ionic concentration-polarisation model of Geraldes & Afonso (J. Membr. Sci. 300 (2007) 20): for every row of a measured dataset (bulk and permeate concentration per ion, volume flux) it prices each ion's mass-transfer coefficient on the ion's OWN diffusivity from the declared correlation, corrects it for suction, and solves the wall concentrations coupled by ONE interface potential gradient fixed by electroneutrality -- no film thickness, no fitted parameter. Publishes per row the polarisation index Gamma_<ion> = (C_m - C_b)/C_b, xi and the wall charge residual, and per ion k_<ion>. Witness polarisation01_geraldes_afonso_table1; gate check_polarisation_coupling recomputes Eqs. (25)-(28) independently.

massTransfer.title: Film-coefficient correlation
massTransfer.description: The cell's correlation, evaluated per ion on the ion's own D0. `StirredCell` (Sh = a (omega r^2/nu)^b Sc^c, k = Sh D/r; Bowen et al. 1997 defaults 0.23/0.567/0.33) needs `omega` and `radius`; `SchockMiquel` (a spacer channel) needs `velocity` and `hydraulicDiameter`. `viscosity` and `density` are REQUIRED (nu = mu/rho).

polarisation.title: Polarisation policy
polarisation.description: The film's POLICY, one block whichever way k arrives (a correlation or a bare `k_film`); declaring these words inside massTransfer {} refuses. `suctionCorrection`: GeraldesAfonso2006 (Xi = phi + (1 + 0.26 phi^1.4)^-1.7), filmTheory (the default: Xi = phi + phi/(e^phi - 1)) or none. `ionCoupling`: electroneutral (the multi-ionic model of Geraldes & Afonso 2007 -- each ion's k on its own D0, one interface potential gradient fixed by electroneutrality at the wall; needs >= 2 charged solutes) or none (the default, announced on an ion-declared feed).

ions.title: Ions
ions.description: Components with an aqueous bridge; charge and D0 come from their species records (an ion whose record carries no D0 refuses by name, naming the `transport { D0 }` remedy).

closeBy.title: Ion derived by electroneutrality
closeBy.description: That ion's bulk AND permeate concentrations are derived from the others by electroneutrality (as a table that reports only the measured ions does); it must be one of `ions` and must not appear in the dataset.

dataset.title: Measured rows
dataset.description: Path to a dataset in the experiments grammar: `columns ( { name C_b_<ion>; unit mol/m3; } ... { name C_p_<ion>; unit mol/m3; } { name J_v; unit m/s; } )` and a flat `data ( ... )` list, one row per operating point.
